body:
## Reproduction

Run the published base image with the documented explicit alternative:

```text
TOKEN_SECRET=...
ALLOW_ANONYMOUS_ADMIN=true
LOGIN_CLI_ARGS=setup-token
```

Then `POST /api/login` returns HTTP 502:

```text
could not start the login flow: Unable to spawn claude because:
No viable candidates found in PATH "/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin:/sbin:/bin"
```

The same v0.77 image can start the default full-scope/native Claude flow, but the `setup-token` alternative promised by #65 and the documentation still depends on an absent vendor binary. The on-demand download/fallback promised by #116 does not make this path viable in the published runtime image.

## Expected behavior

- One published runtime image supports both modes without a custom rebuild:
  - full Claude Code `/login`-equivalent scopes by default;
  - narrow `setup-token` (`user:inference`) only when explicitly selected.
- Prefer an in-process narrow OAuth implementation if legally/protocol-wise possible; otherwise download a pinned/checksummed Claude CLI into a writable cache on demand, with clear supply-chain metadata and no shell installer.
- `doctor` reports whether each auth mode is available before login starts.
- `POST /api/login` and a direct `auth claude` option expose the same explicit mode selection.
- Add a test from the exact published image digest that starts each mode in a fresh container, verifies the expected authorize host/scopes and confirms the waiting session remains alive; no preinstalled host binary or hidden build variant may satisfy the test.
title: Published v0.77 image cannot run the documented setup-token login alternative
